messages:
Nina (docs): Hey folks, PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 — updates the onboarding examples (JS + Python SDK) and a short migration note. Need reviewers and someone to merge in the afternoon window.

Jordan - SDK: I can review the JS snippets. Will check the streaming example and function-calling usage.

ci-bot: Preview build failed: 2 warnings, 1 error (link-check). Error: unresolved anchor /guides/onboard.html#quickstart-python.

Nina (docs): Ugh that anchor used to be #python-quickstart. Looks like the header was reworded. Owen, you edited that page last week—any idea?

Owen: Yep I renamed the header to "Python quick start" (capitalization) and the anchor became #python-quick-start. Quick fix is to update the link in the PR to #python-quick-start. I'll push a tiny commit if you want.

Jordan - SDK: Thanks — I'll also verify the Python snippet formatting. The function-calling example uses `response.stream()` which changed in the new SDK to `client.stream_responses()` in beta. Is it intentional to show the old call?

Priya - Eng: Good catch. Docs should match the public SDK stable API. If the PR references an old beta name, we should change to `client.stream_responses()` or alias it and note the older call is deprecated. I can approve the change once that's fixed.

Nina (docs): Let's keep the stable API. Jordan, can you change the snippet to stream_responses? Also please run `black` on the Python snippet per style.

Jordan - SDK: Will do. Quick question about reviewer ownership: our docs-review rotation is light this sprint. Can someone volunteer to be primary reviewer for onboarding docs? We had a gap after Marissa went on leave.

Liam: I can take primary for onboarding this sprint. Happy to be the merge owner too during the 16:00-17:00 PT window.

Owen: +1 for adding an OWNERS file in /docs/onboarding. That'll help avoid manual pings. Small JSON with emails or GitHub handles.

Nina (docs): I like that. But prefer a lightweight OWNERS: list of reviewers (handles). We should avoid too many process docs. Liam, can you open a follow-up PR to add OWNERS after this lands?

Liam: Yep I'll open it and add @liam, @nina-docs, @jordan-sdk.

ci-bot: New preview build queued after commit.

Jordan - SDK: Pushed fixes: switched to `client.stream_responses()`, ran black, updated the link to #python-quick-start. Tests still green locally.

ci-bot: Preview build passed: 0 errors, 1 warning. Deployed preview: https://deploy-preview-478--docs.redwood.com

Priya - Eng: LGTM from eng after the API rename. One small nit in wording: change "dedicated capacity" -> "dedicated pools" in the migration example to match product copy.

Nina (docs): Thanks — applied the nit. Plan: Liam will merge during 16:00-17:00 PT merge window assuming CI stays green. Jordan, thanks for the quick updates. Owen, please keep an eye on any follow-ups.

Liam: I'll merge at 16:10 PT. If anything blocks, ping me directly.

Nina (docs): Merged. :tada: Created follow-up issue to add OWNERS: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/132

Owen: Great, thanks everyone. Thread resolved unless new blockers appear.

Jordan - SDK: Thanks team — learned about the anchor changes. Will check the rest of the snippets in a follow-up pass.

ci-bot: Merge successful: PR #478 merged by liam.
